name: pythermodb
description: Create validated pyThermoDB references for thermodynamic tables, scalar interactions, observational datasets, and correlations.

interface.shortDescription: Create references and build pyThermoDB objects.
interface.longDescription: Reusable Codex workflows for converting thermodynamic tables, constants, matrix parameters, ordered scalar interactions, observational datasets, and equation correlations into validated pyThermoDB reference YAML, then building and validating pyThermoDB objects from those references.
defaultPrompt: Convert this thermodynamic table into pyThermoDB YAML.
Build a pyThermoDB object from reference YAML.
